spans.s:
प्रथ् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (प्रथते, प्रथित)
1 To
increase (wealth &c.).
--2 To
spread abroad (as fame, rumour
&c.); तथा यशोऽस्य प्रथते

; अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च
प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः

; 9. 76.
--4 To appear, arise, come
to light; श्रमो नु तासां मदनो नु पप्रथे

.
--5 To occur (to mind).
{vII.v} {c10c} U. (प्रथयति-ते, प्रथित)
1 To
spread abroad, proclaim; सज्जना एव
साधूनां प्रथयंति गुणोत्करं Dṛ. Ś. 12;

.
--2 To show,
manifest, display, evince, indicate; परमं
वपुः प्रथयतीव जयं

.
--4 To
disclose.
--5 To spread, extend
--6 To throw, cast.

प्रथनं [प्रथ्-ल्युट्]
1 Spreading,
extension.
--2 Scattering.
--3
Throwing, projecting.
--4 Showing,
[]
evincing, displaying.
--5 A place where
anything is spread.
--6
Celebrating, proclaiming.

.
--2
First, chief, principal, most
excellent or eminent, matchless,
incomparable; Śi. 15. 42;

.
--3
Earliest, most ancient, primary.
--4
Prior, previous, former, earlier;
प्रथमसुकृतापेक्षया

.
--5 (In gram.) The first person
(= third person according to
European phraseology).
--मः
1 The first
(third) person.
--2 The first
consonant of a class.
--मा The
nominative case.
--मं ind.
1 First,
firstly, at first;

.
--3
At once, immediately.
--4 Before;
यात्रायै चोदयामास तं शक्तेः प्रथमं शरत्

.
--5 Newly,
recently. प्रथमं अनंतरं or ततः or पश्चात्
first, afterwards; प्रथमात् firstly, for
the first time; प्रथमतः
1 At first,
firstly;
--2 previously.
--3 immediately;
--4 before, in preference to (gen.)
--Comp.
--अर्धः --र्धं the first half.
--आगामिन् a. first mentioned.
--आदेशः placing at the beginning.
--आश्रमः the first of the four stages
in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa;
i. e. Brahmacarya.
--इतर a. ‘other
than first’, the second.
--उदित a.
first uttered; उवाच धात्र्या
प्रथमोदितं वचः

.
--उत्पन्न a. firstborn.
--कल्पः {1} the best course to adopt.
{2} an excellent suggestion or idea.
--कल्पित a. {1} first thought out. {2}
first in rank or importance.
--कुसुमः
white marjoram.
--गर्भ a. pregnant
for the first time.
--ज a. {1}
firstborn. {2} original, primary.
--दर्शनं
first sight.
--दिवसः the first day;

.
--पुरुषः the first person (=the
third person according to the
English system of treating Sanskrit
grammar).
--मंगल a. highly
auspicious.
--यौवनं early youth or age,
youthful state.
--वयस् n. early age,
youth.
--विता Ved. a first wife.
--विरहः separation for the first time.
--वृत्तांतः antecedents, former
[]
circumstances.
--वैयाकरणः {1} the most
distinguished grammarian. {2} a
beginner in grammar.
--साहसः the first
or lowest of the three degrees of
punishment or fine.
--सुकृतं former
kindness or service.

प्रथित p. p.
1 Increased, extended.
--2 Published, proclaimed, spread,
declared; प्रथितयशसां
भासकविसोमिल्लकविमिश्रादीनां

.
--3 Shown,
displayed, manifested, evinced.
--4
Famous, celebrated, renowned,
wellknown;

.
--5
Intent upon, engaged in, devoted
to.
--6 Spread, stretched.
--तंः N. of
Viṣṇu.

प्रथिमन् m. Breadth, greatness,
extension, magnitude; प्रथिमानं
दधानेन जघनेन घनेन सा

प्रथिष्ठ a. Largest, widest,
broadest; (superl. of पृथु q. v.).

प्रथीयस् a. (सी f.) Larger, wider,
broader; (compar. of पृथु q. v.).

प्रथु a. Wide, wide-spread.
--थुः
An epithet of Viṣṇu.

प्रथुकः Rice parched and flattened
(cf. पृथुक).

प्राथमकल्पिकः^1
1 A student who
has just entered on the study of the
Vedas (शैक्ष).
--2 A Yogin just
commencing his course.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

प्राथमिक a. (की f.)
1 Primary,
first, initial.
--2 Former, previous.
--3 Happening for the first time.
